purpose: Semantic keywords + formulas as parallel leaves for coding-LLM reasoning over funnel, features, and design schema. Leaves do not collide; decide/update one leaf without rewriting siblings.

lanes.funnel: state-machine path, edges, bottlenecks, deaths, gates
lanes.design_schema: MC-OPP-DETECT, MC-JOINT, lifecycle engine, HTF authority, identity, fail-closed

rule: Trace by leaf_id or keyword. Parallel leaves. No silent merge of POP_CAND with POP_EDGE. No APPLY without L-HTF-CFGATE.

funnel_leaves.for_coding_llm: Use this as the only legal state order when labeling bottlenecks or writing transition tests.
funnel_leaves.formula: PATH := RANGE → SWEEP → DISPLACEMENT → EXPANSION → RETEST → EXECUTION (+ SHADOW_PENDING side-path into EXPANSION); ¬(EXPANSION → DISPLACEMENT)
funnel_leaves.run1_ref: L3 note transition=* ; corrected vs earlier mis-ordered funnel

funnel_leaves.for_coding_llm: Count non-self L3 transitions; do not use TRANSITION_COUNTER as a from→to matrix.
funnel_leaves.formula: EDGE(a,b) := |{L3 notes : transition=a→b ∧ a≠b}|; TRANSITION_COUNTER.has_matrix = false; matrix_source = L3.note
funnel_leaves.fix_note: F4 CLOSED + N2: full 17-pair matrix in run1_ref; gap=0; every note has transition=.
funnel_leaves.n2_cleanup_note: Prior run1_ref listed 6 non-self edges only. Full L3 matrix = 17 pairs (self-transitions + DISPLACEMENT/EXPANSION/RETEST/EXECUTION→RANGE + SHADOW_PENDING path + RETEST→RETEST). Σ counts = 47197.

funnel_leaves.for_coding_llm: Bottleneck = drop on PATH edge, not bar-occupancy alone.
funnel_leaves.formula: BN_i := 1 - EDGE(s_i,s_{i+1}) / entries(s_i); primary_BN := [SWEEP→DISP −78%, DISP→EXP −64%, EXP→RETEST −84%, RETEST→EXEC −83%]

funnel_leaves.for_coding_llm: Death reasons from CANDIDATE_LIFECYCLE only; RESET_HTF ≠ SWEEP→RANGE edge count.
funnel_leaves.formula: DEATH(r) := |{c ∈ CANDIDATE_LIFECYCLE : death_reason=r}|; Σ DEATH = 1798; DEATH(RESET_HTF)=1442 (80.2%); DEATH(RESET_HTF) ≠ EDGE(SWEEP,RANGE)

funnel_leaves.for_coding_llm: Score threshold 0.3 is not the main RETEST→EXEC kill; session/bias filters are.
funnel_leaves.formula: PASS_SCORE := score ≥ 0.3; DECISION_DISTANCE: unique_pass=23, unique_fail=1 (CAND-17925); EXECUTION=4 ≪ 23 ⇒ post_score_filters dominate

funnel_leaves.for_coding_llm: After score pass, FILTER_REJECTED reasons cut RETEST→RANGE.
funnel_leaves.fix_note: F2 CLOSED: L3 RETEST→RANGE reasons = off_session:15 + parent_bias LONG:2 + SHORT:2 + None:1. CANDIDATE_LIFECYCLE only exposes FILTER_REJECTED:15 (no bias subtype).
funnel_leaves.formula_note_parent_bias: LONG:2 + SHORT:2 (from L3 notes, not death_reason)
funnel_leaves.formula_note_reason_None: CONFIRMATION_FAILED event exists (CAND-17925) but does not carry a reason label in L3 RETEST→RANGE; do not equate the two without evidence.

feature_leaves.for_coding_llm: 90 trade columns; group before using as model inputs. Identity ≠ features.
feature_leaves.formula: COLS_90 := identity∪geometry∪price∪trend∪vol∪momentum∪structure∪regime∪distances∪live∪cached∪bitnet∪meta; identity ⊇ {trade_id, run_id}; features ⊆ COLS_90 \ identity

feature_leaves.for_coding_llm: Do not equate live_* with non-live or cached_* without an authority rule.
feature_leaves.formula: live_x := value at entry from live metrics path; cached_x := value from CRT cache / prior snapshot; x := feature_pipeline batch value; authority_for_decision := declared_config_key (fail-closed if missing)

feature_leaves.for_coding_llm: On this run BitNet columns are schema stubs, not evaluated scores.
feature_leaves.formula: IF engine.state.bitnet_main_score is None THEN bitnet_score_at_entry=0.0 ∧ bitnet_decision_at_entry=""; stub ≠ model_reject
feature_leaves.fix_note: F6 CLOSED: config use_bitnet=false (threshold 0.55 still present). Engine can set bitnet_main_score when enabled; backtest maps None→0/"". Intentional-off on this run — not broken wiring.

feature_leaves.for_coding_llm: insufficient_data (need 30) means monitor buffer samples, not 30 trades.
feature_leaves.formula: DRIFT_OK ⇔ |buffer| ≥ 30; buffer holds {retest_depth, body_ratio, disp_strength}; site = features/feature_monitor.py; wire = runtime/backtest_v2.py → distribution.feature_drift

feature_leaves.for_coding_llm: L1 is a single observation record; no per-bar feature artifact pointer on this run.
feature_leaves.formula: L1 := 1 row (module=features.feature_pipeline, status=PASS, bar_idx=-1, artifact_path=None, output_hash=None); ≠ per-bar feature store

feature_leaves.for_coding_llm: logs/feature_snapshots.jsonl is a global optional emitter, not a Run1 folder artifact.
feature_leaves.formula: SNAP_PATH := logs/feature_snapshots.jsonl; SNAP ∈ Run1_artifacts = false; emitter ≈ core/engine_runner (optional)

feature_leaves.for_coding_llm: When joining features to layer_trace / events / trades, use L-HTF-IDX offsets.
feature_leaves.formula: join_ts := opened_at = events.timestamp = layer.bar_ts; bar_idx = trades.candle_idx - 1 = events.candle_index + 62

design_leaves.for_coding_llm: Detection authority — opportunity birth. Do not confuse with measurement money authority.
design_leaves.formula: DETECT := MT5 OHLCV → opportunity; immutable = {trade_id, dataset_identity}; nest = dataset_identity → trace_id → analysis_id → run_id → trade_id; schema_change ⇒ User approval

design_leaves.for_coding_llm: Measurement authority — Y_scanner/Y_oracle/Y_joint; money = path only.
design_leaves.formula: STATES_6 := {BOTH_SL, BOTH_TP, BOTH_TIMEOUT, JOINT_STATE_SL_TP, JOINT_STATE_TP_SL, JOINT_STATE_SL_TIMEOUT}; authority_outcome := path_outcome + y_R_net; mismatch ∈ STATES_6 ≠ error

design_leaves.for_coding_llm: Emit-only engine; wraps trail simulate + forward_walk(intrabar_fixed); no new exit semantics.
design_leaves.formula: measure(entry,sl,tp,side,bars) → {Y_scanner, Y_oracle, Y_joint, authority_outcome, rr_*, duration_*, exit_mechanism_*}; specimen ⇒ JOINT_STATE_SL_TP

design_leaves.for_coding_llm: clock_id = cadence; h_ref/l_ref = structure; ResetLogic = lifecycle. Patch PARKED.
design_leaves.formula: clock_id ⊨ lifecycle_cadence; h_ref,l_ref ⊨ sweep_structure; should_reset_today ⊨ clock_flip ∨ retrace ∨ extension; structural_break_patch = PARKED; APPLY ⇔ locks ∧ counterfactual_gate

design_leaves.for_coding_llm: Never mint a new campaign id in measurement; forward trade_id+trace_id.
design_leaves.formula: dataset_identity → trace_id → analysis_id → run_id → trade_id; trade_id mint = sha1(instrument|ts|direction|entry:.8f|sl:.8f)[:16]; unit_id = legacy alias

design_leaves.for_coding_llm: Detection produces candidates; measurement labels them. Separate authorities.
design_leaves.formula: DETECT_AUTH = MT5 OHLCV; MEASURE_AUTH = path / y_R_net; DETECT ∩ MEASURE = trade_id,trace_id forwarded; ¬(scanner_label ⇒ money_truth)

design_leaves.for_coding_llm: Tier-1 CRTConfig keys required; no silent .get defaults.
design_leaves.formula: Tier1 = {body_ratio_min, atr_multiplier_min, expansion_atr_min_distance, retest_depth_max}; missing_key ⇒ fail_closed; shipped fail-closed A = 09ffcb1
